algorithm: {For each bin, compute the remaining capacity after placing the given item, assign a priority equal to the negative of this remaining capacity if the bin can accommodate the item, otherwise assign a priority of negative infinity to prioritize bins that will have the least leftover space after adding the item}
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    priorities[valid_mask] = -(bins[valid_mask] - item)
    return priorities
